subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The guide said every calendar reflects what a society needs to organize.”?
options: The students realized that the card mattered as much as the food.
Students realized timekeeping is not only counting days.
Students complained for a few days.
Students realized that history is not only made by leaders.

本文可直接核對「The guide said every calendar reflects what a society needs to organize. Students realized timekeeping is not only counting days.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The guide said every calendar reflects what a society needs to organize. Students realized timekeeping is not only counting days.」，答案為「Students realized timekeeping is not only counting days.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Students realized timekeeping is not only counting days.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
